answer: Agents resist Sybil attacks by forcing every identity to lock an onyx bond of capital for 30 epochs while posting unique key-bound compute proofs into a shared nebula of activity graphs. A random mesa of auditors samples 10 percent of nodes each epoch; failed challenges or anomalous density slash the bond and eject the node.
